```{r}
#loading the packages
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(tidyverse)
library(PRROC)

#loading the training and testing datasets
library(data.table)
train_val_df <- as.data.frame(fread("final_train_set_model1.tsv"))
test_df      <- as.data.frame(fread("final_test_set_model1_fixed.tsv"))


exclude_cols <- c("target", "score") # Adjust "target" if your label column is named differently

# Separate features (X) and target label (y)
X_train_val <- train_val_df %>% select(-all_of(exclude_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
y_train_val <- train_val_df$target

X_test <- test_df %>% select(-all_of(exclude_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
y_test <- test_df$target
stopifnot(is.numeric(X_train_val), identical(colnames(X_train_val), colnames(X_test)))


dtrain_val <- xgb.DMatrix(X_train_val, label = y_train_val)
dtest      <- xgb.DMatrix(X_test,      label = y_test)

chrom_ids <- fread("train_val_ids.csv")$chrom          # same row order as train_val.csv
stopifnot(length(chrom_ids) == nrow(X_train_val))
```


```{r}
#5-fold cross validation
set.seed(42)
chroms        <- unique(chrom_ids)
fold_of_chrom <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(chroms)))
folds <- lapply(1:5, function(k) which(chrom_ids %in% chroms[fold_of_chrom == k]))
print(sapply(folds, length))   # check sizes are roughly balanced; change the seed if one fold is huge


fold_balance <- data.frame(
  fold = 1:5,
  n    = sapply(folds, length),
  pos  = sapply(folds, function(idx) sum(y_train_val[idx] == 1)),
  neg  = sapply(folds, function(idx) sum(y_train_val[idx] == 0))
)
fold_balance$pos_frac <- round(fold_balance$pos / fold_balance$n, 3)
print(fold_balance)

# Build the fold DMatrices once (they don't change between grid rows)
fold_data <- lapply(folds, function(val_idx) {
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X_train_val)), val_idx)
  list(
    dtrain  = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_val[train_idx, ], label = y_train_val[train_idx]),
    dval    = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_val[val_idx, ],   label = y_train_val[val_idx]),
    actuals = y_train_val[val_idx]
  )
})

# 1. Hyperparameter grid (nrounds is evaluated inside, not a grid axis)
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth        = c(3, 4, 6),
  eta              = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 5)
)
nrounds_set <- c(100, 200, 400, 600)
max_rounds  <- max(nrounds_set)

cat(sprintf("--- Grid search: %d combinations x %d round counts, 5 chromosome-grouped folds ---\n\n",
            nrow(hyper_grid), length(nrounds_set)))

# 2. Grid search
results <- list()

for (g in seq_len(nrow(hyper_grid))) {

  params_curr <- list(
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "logloss",
    max_depth        = hyper_grid$max_depth[g],
    eta              = hyper_grid$eta[g],
    min_child_weight = hyper_grid$min_child_weight[g],
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    seed             = 42
  )

  # metrics[round_idx, fold]
  roc_m <- pr_m <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(nrounds_set), ncol = 5)

  for (i in 1:5) {
    fd <- fold_data[[i]]

    # Train ONCE per fold at the maximum number of rounds
    model_fold <- xgb.train(params = params_curr, data = fd$dtrain,
                            nrounds = max_rounds, verbose = 0)

    # Score the same model at each smaller round count
    for (r in seq_along(nrounds_set)) {
      nr        <- nrounds_set[r]
      val_probs <- predict(model_fold, fd$dval, iterationrange = c(1, nr))

      roc_m[r, i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc(fd$actuals, val_probs,
                                        levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)))
      pr_m[r, i]  <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = val_probs[fd$actuals == 1],
                              scores.class1 = val_probs[fd$actuals == 0])$auc.integral
    }
  }

  for (r in seq_along(nrounds_set)) {
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      max_depth        = hyper_grid$max_depth[g],
      eta              = hyper_grid$eta[g],
      min_child_weight = hyper_grid$min_child_weight[g],
      nrounds          = nrounds_set[r],
      Mean_PR_AUC      = mean(pr_m[r, ]),
      SD_PR_AUC        = sd(pr_m[r, ]),
      Mean_ROC_AUC     = mean(roc_m[r, ]),
      SD_ROC_AUC       = sd(roc_m[r, ])
    )
  }

  best_here <- max(sapply(tail(results, length(nrounds_set)), function(d) d$Mean_PR_AUC))
  cat(sprintf("Grid %2d/%d | depth: %d | eta: %.2f | mcw: %d ==> best Mean PR-AUC across rounds: %.4f\n",
              g, nrow(hyper_grid), hyper_grid$max_depth[g], hyper_grid$eta[g],
              hyper_grid$min_child_weight[g], best_here))
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results) %>% arrange(desc(Mean_PR_AUC))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 COMBINATIONS (by mean PR-AUC) ===\n")
print(head(results_df, 10), digits = 4)


```

```{r}

#3. choosing the best parameter values
#  1-SE simplest model
# Change to `simple_row` if you want the regularized/simpler model
use_one_se <- TRUE 
best_row <- results_df[1, ]

threshold <- best_row$Mean_PR_AUC - best_row$SD_PR_AUC
simple_row <- results_df %>%
  filter(Mean_PR_AUC >= threshold) %>%
  arrange(max_depth, nrounds, desc(min_child_weight), eta) %>%
  slice(1)

cat("\nBest by mean PR-AUC:\n");        print(best_row, digits = 4)
cat("\nSimplest within 1 SD of best:\n"); print(simple_row, digits = 4)

chosen <- if (use_one_se) simple_row else best_row

best_params <- list(
  objective        = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric      = "logloss",
  max_depth        = chosen$max_depth,
  eta              = chosen$eta,
  min_child_weight = chosen$min_child_weight,
  subsample        = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  seed             = 42
)
best_nrounds <- chosen$nrounds

cat(sprintf("\nChosen (%s): max_depth=%d, eta=%.2f, min_child_weight=%d, nrounds=%d\n",
            ifelse(use_one_se, "1-SE Rule", "Absolute Best"),
            best_params$max_depth, best_params$eta,
            best_params$min_child_weight, best_nrounds))
```

```{r}
# 1. Train final model on the entire train/val pool
set.seed(42)
final_model <- xgb.train(params = best_params, data = dtrain_val,
                         nrounds = best_nrounds, verbose = 0)

# 2. Predict on the held-out test chromosomes
test_probs <- predict(final_model, dtest)
test_preds <- as.integer(test_probs >= 0.50)

# 3. Metrics
tp <- sum(y_test == 1 & test_preds == 1)
fp <- sum(y_test == 0 & test_preds == 1)
fn <- sum(y_test == 1 & test_preds == 0)
tn <- sum(y_test == 0 & test_preds == 0)

test_roc_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc(y_test, test_probs, levels = c(0, 1),
                                   direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)))
test_pr_auc  <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = test_probs[y_test == 1],
                         scores.class1 = test_probs[y_test == 0])$auc.integral

test_precision <- ifelse(tp + fp == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fp))
test_recall    <- ifelse(tp + fn == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fn))
# 4. Print results
cat("====================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("=== HOLDOUT TEST SET PERFORMANCE (N = %d sites) ===\n", length(y_test)))
cat("====================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("ROC-AUC   : %.4f\n", test_roc_auc))
cat(sprintf("PR-AUC    : %.4f  (baseline %.3f)\n", test_pr_auc, mean(y_test)))
cat(sprintf("Precision : %.4f\n", test_precision))
cat(sprintf("Recall    : %.4f\n", test_recall))
cat("====================================================\n")
print(table(Predicted = test_preds, Actual = y_test))
```


```{r}
# Calculate feature importance matrix from the final model
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = final_model)
imp_plot <- importance_matrix %>%
  slice_max(Gain, n = 12) %>%
  mutate(rel_gain = Gain / max(Gain)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rel_gain, y = reorder(Feature, rel_gain))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2b7bb9", width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Relative importance (gain)", y = NULL, title = "Model 1") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
imp_plot
ggsave("importance_model1.pdf", imp_plot, width = 4.5, height = 3.5)
```
```{r}
ids <- fread("test_ids_fixed.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(ids) == length(test_probs))
pred_out <- ids %>% mutate(label = y_test, prob = test_probs, pred = test_preds,
  group = case_when(label == 1 & pred == 1 ~ "TP", label == 0 & pred == 0 ~ "TN",
                    label == 0 & pred == 1 ~ "FP", label == 1 & pred == 0 ~ "FN"))
write_tsv(pred_out, "test_predictions_model1.tsv")
table(pred_out$group)   # should match the confusion matrix

# per-site contributions: which features pushed each prediction up or down (SHAP values)
contrib <- predict(final_model, dtest, predcontrib = TRUE)
write_tsv(bind_cols(ids, as_tibble(contrib)), "test_contributions_model1.tsv")
```
